steps.content: Jasmine's appearance immediately puts everyone on high alert.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: What is her objective? Same as those Outland extremists from just now? There are too many viable targets here.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Don't you dare harm Chief!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No—I'm not her target, you are! FAC soldiers, fall back now! Paradeisos has me covered. Stay away from her!

It's too late. The pink figure glides through the crowd like a serpent. Before anyone can react, crimson blooms across the soldiers' white armor—one after another, they crumple. Blood rushes to your head.

The prohibition takes effect, sending spikes of light thrusting out from Jasmine's body. She stumbles, nearly losing her balance, but quickly dissipates the impact with a smooth roll as she hits the ground.
She looks up at you, not the slightest bit annoyed, wearing the same cheerful smile she always has for you.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: ...Are you really serious? Use your power against me? I'm the only one who can control these blades, you know.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: These blades only obey me. If you force those shackles on me, you're just surrendering my body to them. And then... these cursed blades will wield an S-Class Sinner's power. What do you think would happen then?

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Hahaha, let's not go there, okay? I'd hate to lose myself... I'd hate to let these wretched things hurt you.

Though reluctant to admit it, you know she isn't lying. Through the shackles, you feel it—something stirring inside Jasmine. Not just one presence, but countless voices, twisted together in a chorus of roars, howls, and sheer madness. You've heard these sounds before, the same ones that echo across that shattered battlefield deep within her mind, where such chaos reigned unchecked.
And you know exactly where these maddened voices come from.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Drop those blades now! Their Mania is already influencing you! Put them down!

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Influencing me? No, I pull the strings here. They want me to slaughter everyone I see, just like how they killed my celebration... Ahaha, why would I ever listen to them?

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: I have no interest in killing—I just want your blade.
She hurls the blade from her left hand, slicing clean through the armor of a soldier charging from behind. His raised battle axe halts mid-swing, frozen in the air.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Let go of that axe, or I'll finish you off too!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Drop your weapons! DROP THEM!!

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Don't fall back! Stop her! AAGH—!!

The soldier's hand gripping the battle axe—along with the entire arm—is sliced into multiple pieces by Jasmine. Those twin blades carve through his armor, slicing through flesh and bone as effortlessly as a knife through silk.

Schorl takes aim and fires a rapid burst from within the safety of your cover, but Jasmine moves too fast. With lightning reflexes, she twists aside, seizing an FAC soldier and hauling him into the line of fire. When Jasmine steps back into view, her face is splattered with crimson, her smile chilling enough to freeze blood.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The combat capabilities of this generic model are limited. Chief, I can only guarantee your personal safety. Please maintain your distance.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: This woman possesses exceptional battlefield judgment and remarkable reflexes. Her intelligence is on par with—or perhaps even sharper than—that of an average person. It's highly likely that her behavior in the medical ward was an act. Don't waste any compassion on her.
Schorl's communications with you have always been close-range and barely audible, yet somehow Jasmine catches every word from that distance.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: I'm smart? I'm normal? Hahahahaha, that makes me so happy!

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: But Chief... what I see, what I hear, what I smell—it's all different from you. Those precious things you care about? To me... they're just a waste.
[Scene Change] Suddenly overlay the current scene with a battlefield flashback filter in black and white with red accents
The shackles violently resonate as the scene before her fades to a pale wash—just like in her dreams.
But Jasmine freezes. She gazes at you across the vast distance, and all you can make out are the scars etched into her skin gradually glowing red.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: The meat I eat always tastes like charred human flesh, and the water I drink forever reeks of blood. And I have to step so, so lightly... because one wrong move and a landmine might explode! But you know what? Landmines also make pretty fireworks!

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Hard to imagine? Don't worry, you only need to visit a battlefield once to understand—life isn't really that precious.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: People beg for life, shameless as stray dogs, only to die like crushed insects. Burned or chopped up, they're just sludge—no more noble than garbage beneath your feet. You see it once, and you'll never escape it. It clings to you... follows you everywhere.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: ...But it's fine. My mind went crazy—it doesn't hurt anymore. Artillery shells are fireworks, machine guns war drums, blood just another wine. Dead men don't care which side they fought for... so they'll all make peace, watch me dance, and applaud me. Isn't that what a celebration should be?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Your war ended a long time ago, and no one here was part of it. Do you really want to side with them and take revenge on all of DisCity?
She doesn't answer you directly. In her eyes, you see a flicker of gratitude, a touch of regret, a hint of apology—and unwavering determination.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Thank you for pitying me, for not killing me right when we met, and for letting me take this stage. Now... I must complete my unfinished performance. So please... don't interrupt again.

She pays no more attention to the soldiers writhing in agony, their weapons shattered, their threat extinguished. Her eyes sweep the battlefield before locking onto a distant point—her gaze sharp, unyielding.
In that direction stands the heavily fortified FAC command motorcade.

steps.speaker: FAC Commander
steps.content: What, is she targetting...?!

steps.speaker: FAC Commander
steps.content: She's targeting the Commander-in-Chief!!! Protect him!! Don't let her get close! Aah—!!

It's too late. She moves like a storm—cutting through resistance, closing the distance in seconds. In one fluid motion, she leaps onto the vehicle, her blade carving open the roof. Through the jagged breach, she stares down, unblinking, as if confirming a final memory across years of time.
Then her face twists into a manic grin, a terrifying blend of joy and fury—she found him. Finally found him.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: ...It really is you!
Schorl strikes with deadly precision at her flank, driving her into a relentless dance of evasion until she leaps from the roof of the vehicle. The instant her feet touch the ground—

You unleash the prohibition once more, this time at point-blank range. Spikes of light spear through her, shackling her body and will. Before those frenzied blades can claim control, you surge forward, pinning her down, wrestling her wrists, and firmly securing those twin blades. Then—
[Release the shackles]

The shackles drive deep through both your hands, firmly binding them together while also nailing down those blood-soaked blades. Schorl's voice cuts through the chaos yet fails to reach your ears with clarity. Then, like a nightmare given form, corruption crashes against your shackles, forcing you to use all your strength to suppress it.
...Oh right, Jasmine is still pinned down by you and your shackles. You should probably say something to her.

steps.speaker: Option
options: This way there's nothing to worry about.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...You've been possessed by these blades. I'll keep both you and your weapon in control.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Letting you back on the battlefield was my mistake. Now, no matter who you're after, it's time to go back to the Bureau.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Don't—let go! It's dangerous!
Jasmine stares at you, her eyes filled with terror—an expression you've never seen on her face before. She struggles to break free from your grip, desperately trying to make you let go.

Meanwhile, the blades in your hands tremble violently, sending pain through your nerves as they unleash a torrent of chaotic hallucinations. Fragments of flesh, thunderous roars, blood, agonized screams, and putrid stench begin to seep into your mind. Amid all the madness, you hear it: an irresistible voice.

steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: She's an Outland spy... She fooled you... A murderous criminal... Look how many have died because of her, think of how many more she plans to kill.

steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: This is war. Remember your position. Enemies deserve no mercy. Kill her. Kill her... Kill her...

steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: Who knows how many times she's wanted to slit your throat!
steps.female_content: ...Kill her, be the last one standing, kill them all... or they'll do the same to you...

steps.content: You hear gunfire and wailing cries, alongside gleeful music and celebration songs. Hell and festivity shatter and merge into one. Every FAC soldier transforms into a pitch-black butcher but also prey to be killed—this is the world one sees when gripping the blades.
In your eyes, Jasmine's face has contorted into something monstrous, her features savage and fierce. You wonder... how does she see you now?
When you both grip the weapon capable of killing each other, when the same deadly enchantment claims you, when your gazes lock in burning intensity—what thoughts break through then?
[Flashback] Display the lap-lying small CG, blank screen for 1 second, then return

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Does our promise... still count?

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: ...I never forgot...
The murderous glint in her eyes softens. She leans closer, her breath warm against your skin. With deliberate tenderness, she licks the blood from the corner of your eye.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: I like our promise a lot, and I'm doing everything I can to keep it. I want to finish this quickly—then go back to your side, and go anywhere with you.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: But if I can't make it back, don't blame me, okay? It's war, after all...

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: The most beautiful promises are always the easiest to break.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: ...And I've been trapped for too long.

This is your final moment together, though in reality, it lasts barely a minute. Broken weapons—guns, blades, axes—rain down from above. Before you can even grasp what's happening, Jasmine awakens. And just like that, she's back on the battlefield.

She lets you take her hands—only to hook her legs around your waist in one fluid motion. With a sharp twist of her hips, she flips you effortlessly, hurling you aside. The instant you're clear, a steel rod spears through her calf.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Thank you, ${PlayerName}. Because of you, I can almost believe... that not everyone's blood is cold, that kindness still exists in this world.

You tumble across the ground, the world spinning in a dizzying blur. Before you can regain your footing, a massive metal plate hurtles toward you with terrifying speed, pinning you to the ground. You no longer have the strength to break free.

steps.speaker: FAC Commander
steps.content: Now's our chance! Pin her down!! Get Chief back!

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: ...This should keep you safe for now. My priority now is neutralizing the out-of-control Sinner. I'll return as soon as possible.
The battle erupts once more.

The metal plate shields you from stray bullets, but it also steals your vision. All you have now is sound: the relentless staccato of gunfire and the earth-shaking collisions of Mania-fueled powers. Jasmine's laughter is gone, swallowed by the violence. The only way to trace her now is through the fury and agony erupting in her wake.
Before the shackles completely break apart, you hear her final cry.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: I have no interest in killing people, but... you're not really human, are you?! You're nothing but DisCity's blade!

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: So DIE!!
